newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk automotive exports rise 17 pct in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Turk automotive exports rise 17 pct in Jan-Oct.

text.p: Turkish automotive exports rose by 17 percent to $1.093 billion in the first ten months of 1996, compared to the same period last year, the automotive industry association (OSD) said in its October monthly bulletin.

Motor vehicle exports rose by 30 percent to $448.03 million, helped by $236.76 million of passenger car exports, up 17 percent and $160.56 million worth of buses, soaring 86 percent from the same period in 1995.
Automotive-allied industry exports rose by nine percent to $644.65 in the January-October period. Tyre exports, the leading item, dropped one percent to 190.3 million.
Turkey's total automotive sector exports in 1995 were $1.189 billion, compared to $750.3 million in 1994.
Turkish automotive output rose by six percent in the first ten months of 1996 to 267,376, including 172,964 cars, down seven percent from the same 1995 period.
